newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain March jobs data show industry confident - govt.
newsitem.headline: Spain March jobs data show industry confident - govt.

text.p: The Spanish government welcomed an improvement in March jobless data on Monday, which showed a fall in the unemployment rate to 13.89 percent from 14.11 percent in February.

"The government values the performance of employment very positively...the March data shows the confidence of the industrial sectors in the pace of the Spanish economy," Labour Secretary General Manuel Pimentel told a press conference.
In terms of sectors, construction showed the biggest improvement registering a 3.6 percent rise in employment.
